questions.stem: A 55-year-old woman presents to the ER with lethargy and blood pressure of 250/150. and complaining of severe headache and visual disturbance. She has history of uncontrolled bronchial asthma. On physical examination, retinal hemorrhages are present. Neurological examination reveals no focal weakness. Serum creatinine is normal. Which of the following is the best approach?
